answer: Reaching the opal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on homomorphic encryption for private computation. Written in a security-first mindset, threat model explicit register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Each submission hangs on the vault of a task receipt, and the delta is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
